question: In that joke about the woman reading her Bible on a plane, what did she say she would do about how the man who was swallowed by the whale survived?

steps.text: Plan: find the joke email (woman reading Bible on plane, Jonah and the whale), then read it for her answer.

steps.arguments: {"query": "woman reading Bible on airplane Jonah swallowed by whale, she'll ask him when she gets to heaven"}
steps.summary: 10 results, 10 of them people's own mail

answer:
She said she would ask Jonah herself when she got to heaven.

In the joke, "You Gotta Have Faith" (email dated 2000-12-11, from suhernan@llgm.com), a Christian lady who flew a lot for business brought her Bible to read because it helped relax her. The man next to her chuckled and asked whether she really believed "all that stuff in there." He asked about the man swallowed by the whale, and she answered "Oh, Jonah. Yes, I believe that, it is in the Bible." He then asked how Jonah could have survived inside the whale.

Her reply: "Well, I don't really know. I guess when I get to heaven, I will ask him." The punchline came next. The man asked sarcastically, "What if he isn't in heaven?" and she answered, "Then you can ask him."

citations.cited_text:
There was this Christian lady that had to do a lot of traveling for her
business, so she did a lot of flying. Flying made her nervous, so she
always took her Bible along with her to read and it helped relax her.

One time, she was sitting next to a man. When he saw her pull out her
Bible, he gave a little chuckle and went back to what he was doing. After
awhile, he turned to her and asked, "You don't really believe all that stuff
in there do you?"

The lady replied, "Of course I do. It is the Bible."
He said, "Well, what about that guy that was swallowed by that whale?"
She replied, "Oh, Jonah. Yes, I believe that, it is in the Bible."
He asked, "Well, how do you suppose he survived all that time inside the
whale?"

The lady said, "Well, I don't really know. I guess when I get to heaven, I
will ask him."
"What if he isn't in heaven?" the man asked sarcastically.
"Then you can ask him." replied the lady.
